data.narrative:
Resolute Grid is a seed-stage company operating in the Climate & Energy sector. The comparable universe consists of one public company and eight private peers identified within the sector, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix. However, the peer set presents meaningful constraints for valuation.

Peer-median triangulation is not applicable in this case. Analysis identified zero same-stage seed peers, zero adjacent-stage peers, and zero peers within a comparable valuation tier. While eight companies operate within Climate & Energy broadly, the narrow filtering criteria—necessary to control for stage, growth profile, and capital intensity—yielded insufficient datapoints to support a reliable median multiple. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable noise given the heterogeneity of the broader Climate & Energy landscape across different technology types and commercialization timelines.

This analysis cannot support a triangulated valuation at this time. The primary limiting factor is the absence of sufficiently granular comparable data at the seed stage within this sector. A defensible range would require either: additional seed-stage climate companies with disclosed valuations; revenue or capital efficiency metrics that permit cross-stage normalization; or transaction multiples from recent rounds. Investors should prioritize direct fundamentals assessment—including technology differentiation, team experience in capital-intensive sectors, and path to capital efficiency—as the primary valuation drivers until comparable data improves.
